assertions.name: marionette_newsession_ppoll_boundary
assertions.expected: After TCP notification, Firefox returns a bounded NewSession response; ppoll boundary identifies the waiting path
assertions.actual: TCP peer-process, socket-events and pollee-notify occurred; Firefox parent ppoll(nfds=3, timeout=0) returned 0 at call 8192, but no NewSession response arrived before desktop-timeout
